It’s a moment to slow down, pay attention to yourself, and set a positive tone. Feeling prepared often comes from these small acts of self-care, and that boost in self-assurance can carry through your interactions and tasks.

If it makes you feel good and ready to face the day, then it’s absolutely worthwhile. It’s a personal ritual that honors both your presentation and your mindset. Keep doing what works for you!
